summary: Five new situations that the saved set does not cover yet, mostly triggers and objections.

items.text: Our alarm panel at the warehouse only emails the office when a freezer gets too warm. How can the night manager get that as a text instead?
items.detail: Source: trigger event · Maps to: Step 3: Point your existing tools at your text address

items.text: I run a church office and want to text all our volunteers from Outlook when Sunday plans change, without everyone downloading an app. Is that possible?
items.detail: Source: title/meta/H1 · Maps to: Sending to Your Whole Team

items.text: If I forward a scheduling email to a text alert service, do the customers see my office email address or a phone number when the text arrives?
items.detail: Source: objection · Maps to: FAQ: What number do texts come from?

items.text: We are a ten-person HVAC company. Is it cheaper to pay a texting service monthly or to hire a freelancer to build something on Twilio?
items.detail: Source: objection · Maps to: Method 3 comparison table

items.text: Our help desk sends ticket alerts by email, but my on-call tech misses them at night. What is the simplest way to turn those into texts?
items.detail: Source: trigger event · Maps to: Step 5: Common setups (IT and help desk row)
